answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after a long season of honest, verifiable work, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive rather than free. A newcomer starts in a narrow canyon of low trust, with tiny transaction limits, and must earn its way out through completed tasks checked by independent peers. No shortcut buys a safe haven: stake, time and compute are all spent per identity, and a sudden delta in behaviour, many accounts acting alike at once, triggers extra proof and freezes rewards until reviewed.
